description: WFPS Call Logs is published by Open Data Services. The WFPS log records medical and fire-rescue calls, responding units and incident closure times. Its stated coverage is Winnipeg, Canada; calls from 2015 onward. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. A received call does not necessarily result in a unit being dispatched. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
